prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
competitors_mentioned: Five Star Painting of St. Louis
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” painter for every home, but **Kennedy Painting** looks like a strong first company to contact: it’s BBB-accredited and offers interior painting along with drywall and plaster repair, carpentry, and color consultation. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/saint-louis/profile/painting-contractors/kennedy-painting-llc-0734-310243770)

Also worth comparing:

- **Five Star Painting of St. Louis** — BBB-accredited, A+ rated, and offers interior painting and drywall repair. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/wildwood/profile/painting-contractors/five-star-painting-of-st-louis-0734-310613215)
- **Shahid Painting & Decorating** — BBB-accredited, A+ rated, with residential and commercial interior painting. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/saint-louis/profile/painting-contractors/shahid-painting-and-decorating-0734-1000036821)

I’d get **three written estimates** and compare prep work, paint brand, number of coats, cleanup, warranty, and proof of insurance—not just the total price. Ratings and availability can change, so check recent reviews before booking.
